description: This file is a Markdown documentation/tutorial explaining how to implement a simple OAuth2 password-based authentication flow using FastAPI. It contains step-by-step instructions, code snippets, and explanations about handling username/password forms, scopes, hashing passwords, and token generation, aimed at guiding developers through setting up secure API authentication.
